description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing 'units' within a project, including actions for listing, editing, creating, updating, deleting units, and managing unit conversions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Unit
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing units and their conversions within the Coocook project.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles listing units, their usage, and conversions.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a unit by ID for further actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific unit, including conversions and related articles.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new unit related to the project.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Performs the actual insert or update of a unit, with validation.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the appropriate page after operations.
